ordered_branches.explanation: Privately verified configuration flag Y selects item-scoped checks; otherwise checks all SERIAL_NUMBER rows. Item/company context precedence is nonzero receipt container, then location inventory, then shipping container. Under global Y plus @allowDuplicates=N, checks each attachment type for same item, null-safe company and ISNULL(template,0) equality. Other @allowDuplicates values use item only, without company/template filtering. Every check excludes OBJECT_ID=@objectId using <>: default NULL objectId makes this predicate unknown and can report1 even for duplicate serials. Default NULL serial also cannot match. Config scalar subquery can fail on duplicate rows; no warehouse restriction or uniqueness-enforcing write.

source_structure.declaration: CREATE PROCEDURE ValidateSerialNumberIsUnique ( @objectId numeric(9) = null, @serialNum nvarchar(50) = null, @allowDuplicates nchar(1) = null, @templateId numeric(9) = null, @locInvNum numeric(9) = null, @recContNum numeric(9) = null, @shipContNum numeric(9) = null) AS

program.text: SET @allowDuplicateSNInDB = (SELECT SYSTEM_VALUE FROM SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL WHERE RECORD_TYPE=N'<literal:1>' AND SYS_KEY = N'<literal:2>');
SELECT @item =ITEM ,@company = COMPANY FROM RECEIPT_CONTAINER WHERE INTERNAL_REC_CONT_NUM = @recContNum;
SELECT @item =ITEM ,@company = COMPANY FROM LOCATION_INVENTORY WHERE INTERNAL_LOCATION_INV = @locInvNum;
SELECT @item =ITEM ,@company = COMPANY FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER WHERE INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM = @shipContNum;
SET @serialNumCount = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SERIAL_NUMBER SN,RECEIPT_CONTAINER RC
AND ((@company is null AND RC.COMPANY is null) OR (@company = RC.COMPANY))
SET @serialNumCount = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SERIAL_NUMBER SN,LOCATION_INVENTORY LI
AND ((@company is null AND LI.COMPANY is null) OR (@company = LI.COMPANY))
SET @serialNumCount = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SERIAL_NUMBER SN,SHIPPING_CONTAINER SC
AND ((@company is null AND SC.COMPANY is null) OR (@company = SC.COMPANY))
SET @serialNumCount = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SERIAL_NUMBER WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = @serialNum AND OBJECT_ID <> @objectId)
